tr.title: Term Finance Protokolunde 8.5 Milyon Dolarlik Saldiri
slides: Term Finance protokolunde 8.5 milyon dolarlik bir saldiri tespit edildi
Saldiri Meta Vaults yonetim acigindan yararlanarak gerceklesti
Kasalardaki Ethereum mevduatinin neredeyse tamami bosaltildi
Term Meta Vaults kalici olarak kapatti ve sorusturma baslatti
tr.caption:
Term Finance protokolu, Meta Vaults yonetim acigi saldirisinda tahmini 8.5 milyon dolar kaybetti. Saldirida $ETH varliklarinin neredeyse tamami bosaltildi. Protokol Meta Vaults kalici olarak kapattigini acikladi.

#DeFi #Ethereum #Guvenlik

Kaynaklar: Cointelegraph

Bu video yapay zeka destekli olarak hazirlanmistir; yatirim tavsiyesi degildir. Kendi arastirmanizi yapiniz (DYOR).

en.title: Term Finance Hit by 8.5 Million Dollar Vault Exploit
slides: Term Finance protocol hit by an 8.5 million dollar exploit
The attack targeted a governance vulnerability in Meta Vaults
Nearly all Ethereum deposits were drained from the vaults
Term has permanently closed Meta Vaults and launched an investigation
en.caption:
Term Finance lost an estimated 8.5 million dollars in a Meta Vaults governance exploit. The attack drained nearly all $ETH deposits from the vaults. The protocol has permanently closed its Meta Vaults.

#DeFi #Ethereum #Security

Sources: Cointelegraph
